description:
Thinnest end-to-end slice across the real service boundaries: create a GA event, survive a contended reservation, pay via the fake PSP into an append-only journal, deliver a QR ticket, scan it at the gate. The only epic decomposed now (US-001…US-006 = TKT-25…TKT-30).

**Conditions of Success:**
- Scripted demo from the brief's success metric passes on a clean machine and in CI
- All five services + gateway + storefront + scanner run under one `docker compose up`
- Zero oversell proven under concurrent load as part of the local gate

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.

### Implementation readiness — CONCERNS
| Criterion | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Quality gates extracted | OK | PRD §Quality gates; concretized by US-001 |
| Vertical slices | OK | each US demoable alone |
| Sizing | WARN | US-001 (TKT-25) will exceed the ~400-line guide — scaffolding is bulky config; splitting it horizontally would be worse |
| Prefactoring first | OK | US-001 is the prefactor slice |
| Dependency order | WARN | strictly serial chain US-001→…→US-006: no parallel M1 work; US-005/US-006 UI shells could start early against contract stubs if parallelism is wanted |
| AC verifiable | OK | all criteria observable/testable |
| Links + cycle check | OK | linear chain TKT-25→30, no cycles |
| Context-mémo baked | OK | ADR bindings verbatim + PRD refs on each child |
| Unvalidated assumptions | WARN | brief lists: services-on-Compose overhead for a solo team (ADR-002), NF525 ISCA characterization inferred not verified (ADR-003/TKT-11) |

**Concerns:** 1) TKT-25 oversized vs review guide (accepted: scaffold). 2) Serial M1 chain limits parallelism (accepted for a walking skeleton). 3) NF525 referential not yet verified against source text — tracked in TKT-11 COS.

**Verdict:** CONCERNS — proceedable eyes-open; Gate 1: prioritize TKT-25…TKT-30 (and any epics) by dragging to Ready.

Backlog grilling 2026-07-12 (owner decisions): children US-001/002/004/005 amended pre-Gate-1 (observability foundation, FR/EN plumbing, pseudonymous trails); readiness verdict unchanged in substance — sizing concern on US-001 grows slightly with the observability AC.

### Implementation readiness — refresh (final review, still CONCERNS)
Supersedes the graph description in the earlier verdict; criteria table otherwise unchanged.
- Dependency graph is no longer a pure chain: TKT-25 (scaffold) and TKT-39 (Astro spike) are two independent entry points; TKT-39 blocks TKT-26 (US-002) so the storefront shell is decided before storefront UI is built. Cycle check re-run: clean.
- US-001 (TKT-25) has grown again (observability ACs) — the sizing concern stands; consider splitting the tracing/metrics stack into its own slice at planning if it balloons.
- US-002 (TKT-26) now also carries ADR-004 caching + FR/EN plumbing ACs and gained the ADR-005 binding.
**Verdict:** CONCERNS — proceedable eyes-open. Gate 1: TKT-25 and TKT-39 are the claimable starting points.

<!-- sdlc:stage=done kind=metrics -->
### Closeout metrics — TKT-1 / M1 walking skeleton

| stage | duration |
|---|---|
| Backlog | ~1d7h (epic lifecycle; children carried implementation state) |
| Ready | n/a |
| Planning | n/a |
| Building | n/a |
| PO Review | n/a |

**human-wait total:** n/a (measured on child tickets TKT-25…TKT-30)
**diff:** n/a (epic aggregates six implementation PRs plus supporting work)

**Outcome vs COS:** the clean-machine/CI Compose stack is green; the M1 flow creates and publishes a GA event, survives contended reservation without oversell, completes fake-PSP checkout into the append-only journal, issues and delivers a QR ticket, and rejects duplicate redemption at the gate.

**learnings:**
- (technical → docs/architecture.md and ADR-008…012) The five-service boundary held through the full vertical slice; transactional claim, checkout journal, issuance, and redemption decisions are now recorded in repo ADRs.
- (process) A walking skeleton exposed cross-service recovery gaps early enough to isolate them as TKT-43 before real-PSP work.

**retro:**
1. What would have made this ticket faster or better: the epic remained Backlog while all six children completed, obscuring milestone state. Concrete change: add an epic-closeout check after the final child reaches Done; apply to the M2 decomposition/checklist.
2. What should the humans change: update ROADMAP.md in the same closeout pass so milestone state cannot drift from the board. Concrete change: include roadmap reconciliation in the M2-readiness review that follows; pending review findings.
